observed_defect: CM0.8.0 sends source in content but only metadata in structuredContent; native Claude model-visible tool_result selected the latter, so a 2887-source-byte retrieval delivered only a 429-byte metadata JSON.
minimal_change: CM0.8.1 adds source_context equal to the rendered text in structuredContent, preserves snapshot/reference metadata and applies the existing 64000-byte wire cap to both representations together.
controls: Same conditional CM-first prompt/source/grader/models/CLI settings as guided cohort, new balanced fresh pairs, no overlapping timed sessions, actual model-visible source preflight before tasks.
limitations: Post-diagnostic fix on previously used tasks, not held-out generalization or replacement of old results. Wire fix is functional correctness, savings remain to be measured.
